prompt.en: A digital-mode transmit signal is too wide because the radio data input is being overdriven. Which change would NOT help clean up the transmitted audio path?

text.en: Lower the computer playback level feeding the interface
Use the interface attenuator or level control to reduce drive
Restore proper audio isolation if hum is being coupled into the line
Increase RF output power so the distortion is hidden by a stronger signal

explanation.en: More RF power makes a dirty signal stronger; it does not remove audio overdrive. The useful fixes reduce or clean up the audio feeding the transmitter.

prompt.en: A linear regulator has 19 V at its input, 13.8 V at its output, and supplies 3 A. About how much heat must it dissipate?

explanation.en: The regulator drops 19 V - 13.8 V = 5.2 V; 5.2 V x 3 A = 15.6 W of heat.

prompt.en: Spot the error in this safety plan for a qualified technician preparing to troubleshoot ripple in a mains-powered linear supply.

text.en: Unplug the supply and follow the service procedure before handling internal parts
Verify stored capacitor voltage with a meter after the discharge step
Short the main filter capacitor with a screwdriver so it discharges instantly
Use a proper resistor discharge tool or built-in bleeder path where specified

explanation.en: A screwdriver short can cause a dangerous arc and damage parts. Safe service uses de-energizing, controlled discharge, verification, and qualified procedures.
